review_notes:
I read all of Cat.lean. It defines `PointRepresentationCat`, a category of natural point representations of a Hopf algebra H. It carries its own `Hom`, the category and concrete-category instances, a forgetful functor to `SemimoduleCat`, and `isoToLinearEquiv`.

I searched Mathlib for competing concepts: comodule categories, corepresentation, and other structures extending `ModuleCat` or `SemimoduleCat`. The only related declarations are `CoalgCat` (which has no comodule category) and `Rep`. Neither represents natural action on all algebra-valued points of a Hopf algebra, so there is no matching Mathlib concept.

The repo does have a separate `ComoduleCat`. I did not open `Comodule/Equivalence.lean`, which presumably relates the two, so that is unverified. It is an in-repo pairing of two different representations, not a Mathlib duplicate, and the rubric is about Mathlib, Batteries and core.

The file's structure follows the usual Mathlib bundled-category pattern. It is a named API, not a redundant reimplementation. I found no justified duplication finding.
